comment.body:
Thanks for recording that Ctrl+C stores a screenshot, right-click copy works, and disabling PowerToys restores normal text copying, as well as listing the enabled modules. The unresolved ambiguity is which module or application interaction intercepts Ctrl+C, because the report spans many modules and does not name the smallest failing target. Please identify one application and exact text-selection sequence that reproduces it, then comment /bugreport while the failure is active. This will separate a module hook conflict from application-specific clipboard behavior.

**Needed**
1. Please provide One application and minimal failing copy/paste sequence; Use one reproducible application and list numbered steps.
2. Please provide Fresh diagnostics while Ctrl+C produces a screenshot; Reproduce and comment /bugreport immediately afterward.
